entries.name: Cleave
entries.summary: On a hit, a second adjacent creature takes the weapon damage.

entries.name: Graze
entries.summary: On a miss, the target still takes damage equal to the ability modifier.

entries.name: Nick
entries.summary: An extra attack with this weapon can be part of the Attack action.

entries.name: Push
entries.summary: On a hit, push the target 10 feet.

entries.name: Sap
entries.summary: On a hit, the next attack against the target has advantage until your next turn.

entries.name: Slow
entries.summary: On a hit, the target's speed drops by 10 feet.

entries.name: Topple
entries.summary: On a hit, the target makes a save or falls prone.

entries.name: Vex
entries.summary: On a hit, your next attack against the target has advantage.
